lines.en: label norikoafternoongen:
I tap on Noriko's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我戳了戳手机里 Noriko 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: : Hiya! What's going on, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嗨呀！怎么了，老师？

lines.en: : Hey. Are you free right now by any chance?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你现在有空吗？

lines.en: : I'm always free for you! Do you want to meet up?
lines.zh: : 我对你永远有空！你想见一面吗？

lines.en: : The sun's actually starting to come out so I kind of wanted to go for a walk or something.
lines.zh: : 太阳居然出来了，所以我有点想出去走走什么的。

lines.en: : Yeah, that works for me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我没问题。

lines.en: : Is there anywhere in particular you wanted to meet at?
lines.zh: : 你有特别想在哪儿碰头吗？

lines.en: : Uhhhh sure! Give me a few minutes and I'll send you an address.
lines.zh: : 呃——当然！给我几分钟，我把地址发给你。

lines.en: : Sounds good. See you soon.
lines.zh: : 好。待会儿见。

lines.en: : Yup! Bye, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 嗯！再见，老师！

lines.en: scene black
scene norikogenafternoon
Just like Noriko said it would, the sun rains down upon Kumon-mi and actually makes it pretty warm out for the first time in a while.
lines.zh: 正如 Noriko 所说，阳光洒落在 Kumon-mi 上，好久以来第一次让外头变得相当暖和。

lines.en: In fact, the only other place where I've felt this warm since summer has been at the shrine, so this is a pretty pleasant surprise.
lines.zh: 事实上，入夏以来我唯一还感到这么暖的地方就是神社，所以这算是个不小的惊喜。

lines.en: We walk around for a bit, hitting up several convenience stores in search of vegetarian sushi, which is apparently a thing that exists for some reason.
lines.zh: 我们逛了一会儿，连着跑了几家便利店找素食寿司——不知为何，这东西显然是真的存在的。

lines.en: I question Noriko about how she's able to live like that, and she informs me that it's not as hard as I'd expect it to be.
lines.zh: 我问 Noriko 她怎么能这样生活，她告诉我这没我想的那么难。

lines.en: I expect it to be the hardest thing in the world, though, so that doesn't really say much.
lines.zh: 可我本来以为那是世上最难的事，所以这话也没什么分量。

lines.en: Regardless, I respect how she's trying to make a difference. Even if I don't exactly think the difference will be large enough for anyone or anything other than her organs to feel.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我尊重她想做出改变的努力。即便我不太认为这份改变大到能让除她器官以外的任何人或任何东西感受到。

lines.en: scene black
The sun eventually leaves us.
lines.zh: 太阳最终离开了我们。

lines.en: Winter returns.
lines.zh: 冬天回来了。

lines.en: Not having anything else to do and wanting to escape the encroaching cold, we head our separate ways and make plans to meet up again soon.
lines.zh: 别无他事，又想躲开渐浓的寒意，我们便分头离开，约好不久后再见。

lines.en: $ noriko_love += 1
Noriko's affection has increased to [noriko_love]!
lines.zh: Noriko 的好感度提升到了 [noriko_love]!

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
